title: Flow response update properties between mitmweb UI and REST handler
answers: Which files must change when adding or editing flow response properties in mitmweb?
How are editable flow response attributes passed from the mitmweb frontend to backend?
Where are flow update payload keys handled between mitmweb UI and Python backend?
body:
When modifying or adding editable flow response attributes in mitmweb, changes must stay in sync across:
1. Frontend dispatch in `web/src/js/components/FlowView/HttpMessages.tsx:ResponseLine` defining the property name under the `response` payload.
2. Backend REST handler in `mitmproxy/tools/web/app.py:put` mapping JSON keys directly to `mitmproxy.http.Response` attributes.
3. Test cases in `test/mitmproxy/tools/web/test_app.py:test_flow_update` verifying the payload dictionary keys.
Mismatched keys fail silently or produce unhandled attributes because update payloads are dynamically unpacked dictionaries.
applies: mitmweb flow update payloads and endpoints
says: Changes made to response fields in the web inspector fail to save properly.
Updating intercepted response properties in the web interface silently drops our edits.
Allow users to edit and submit updated response attributes from the web UI.
Modified response headers or status values are not updated in the recorded flow.
